fixes.ja: 15年間本当にね、地元のためにやったという自負があるならば、僕は堂々とすべきだと思うんです。
fixes.en: if he truly has the pride that he worked for his local area for 15 years, I think he should hold his head high.
fixes.why: ため is normally written in kana.

fixes.ja: ですからそのためにも地元に帰って、
fixes.en: Therefore, for that sake as well, he should return to his constituency,
fixes.why: ため is normally written in kana.
